prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Baytown, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1238; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you reported at an intersection in Baytown. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give the facts, but I'm [claimant name withheld for the record]. Go ahead.

Q: Thank you. Can you walk me through what happened before the impact?

A: I was making a left turn at a green light. There was a gap in oncoming traffic, so I started through. The other vehicle came from the opposite direction and hit the front passenger side of my car as I was crossing into the lane.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you started your turn?

A: I saw headlights a ways back, but it looked far enough off that I figured I had time. I didn't account for how fast it was coming.

Q: Were you wearing a seatbelt?

A: Yes, the lap and shoulder belt.

Q: Did your airbags deploy?

A: No. The car jolted hard and the seatbelt locked me in place. My head snapped forward and back.

Q: Have you sought medical attention since the collision?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic the same afternoon. They diagnosed a neck strain and a lower back strain. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week since then.

Q: Are you experiencing any symptoms right now?

A: Yes. My neck is stiff, especially when I turn to check mirrors, and my lower back aches after sitting for more than twenty minutes. Some mornings it's hard to get out of bed.

Q: Have you missed any work because of these symptoms?

A: I've taken a few partial days off for appointments. I work a desk job, so I'm managing for now, but it's uncomfortable.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I want the record to show I'm not trying to exaggerate anything. I'm simply trying to get better and get my car repaired.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
